{{Top}}
[[File:MustafarHellscape-SWBC52.png|thumb|right|300px|The Klegger Corp Mining Facility among several active volcanoes on Mustafar]]
'''Volcanoes''' were [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] where [[Magma/Legends|magma]] or lava ejected to the surface of [[Planet/Legends|planetary bodies]]. Many planets were tectonically active resulting in volcanic activity. Planets or [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that contained volcanoes included [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Qat Chrystac/Legends|Qat Chrystac]],<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> [[Lwhekk/Legends|Lwhekk]],<ref name="NEGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Mima II]],<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]],<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Selvaris]],<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> [[Haariden]],<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise">''[[Jedi Quest: The Master of Disguise]]''</ref> [[Nallastia]],<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref> [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> [[Abeloth's planet]],<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> [[Pergitor]],<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> [[Upekzar]],<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]],<ref name="DOTJ:ITV">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> [[Zerist]],<ref name="Eruption">{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}}</ref> [[Taspir III]], and [[Eol Sha]]. [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] contained volcanoes at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a volcano nearly caused the extinction of the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] during their [[Zhell–Taung war|war]] with the [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]], as it [[Destruction of Zhell|destroyed]] their [[Great Zhell|primary city]] on the planet and spit ash in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] for two [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]].<ref name="SOTEs">[[Shadows of the Empire (soundtrack)|''Shadows of the Empire'' soundtrack]]</ref>
